name: ICLR_Subjective-_BenchMark-H20-d5
description: A dataset of subjective human judgments intended to evaluate model outputs on subjective quality/preference tasks. Typically contains paired or multiple candidate outputs with human preference labels or ratings, enabling preference-based evaluation and training. Useful for alignment, human preference modeling, and subjective-quality assessment of language models.
reputation: Relatively obscure/specialized dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited documented community adoption.
